mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size bathroom fan for my needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size bathroom fan depends primarily on the room's square footage. A general guideline is to calculate the room's volume (length x width x height) and divide by 7.5 to get the recommended Cubic Feet per Minute (CFM) rating. For bathrooms over 100 square feet, consider additional factors like shower and toilet compartments. Selecting a fan with adequate CFM ensures efficient moisture removal. We can help calculate the precise CFM needed for your specific bathroom dimensions to ensure optimal performance.
